question.text: Nanda Devi Cat I AIF has engaged Tirupati Merchant Banking Pvt. Ltd. to file its PPM with SEBI. Tirupati Merchant Banking is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the AIF's sponsor. Under SEBI (AIF) Regulations, this arrangement is:

answer.text: Not permitted — the merchant banker appointed by the fund shall NOT be an associate of the AIF, its sponsor, manager or trustee.
Permitted only for Cat II AIFs.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 7 (7.1.4.1 Merchant Bankers): 'A merchant banker, so appointed by the fund, shall NOT be an associate of the AIF, its sponsor, manager or trustee.' The independence requirement is explicit and non-derogable — it protects the diligence integrity of the PPM certificate. The Trap: Options B, C, D all try to work around an absolute prohibition with soft cures (notification, SEBI registration, category carve-outs) that do not exist. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/C Compliance frames this under intermediaries conflict rules; XIX-A tests distributor awareness of MB independence.
